name: יִתְרָן
summary: Borne by Ithran son of Dishon, a Horite of Seir in the line of Esau's land (Gen 36:26; 1Ch 1:41), and by Ithran son of Zophah, an Asherite, who is called Jether in the next verse (1Ch 7:37–38). The name is יֶתֶר “abundance, pre-eminence” with the ending ־ָן; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, וְיִתְרָן and Cheran.”
Among the sons of Zophah, of Asher: “… Shilshah, וְיִתְרָן and Beera.”
“The sons of יֶתֶר: Jephunneh, Pispah and Ara”: the same man as the Ithran of 7:37.

note: Takes j.ef.am (3 tokens). The ending ־ָן is read as the adjectival or name ending (as in יִתְרוֹן “profit” with ־וֹן); the meaning is a reading of the form only. The Asherite is also tagged in names/jether.json.
